# Jack Kelm

> Automation engineer and mechanical engineer based in Northfield, Ohio (Cleveland–Akron area).

## Summary

Jack Kelm is an automation engineer with 9 years of experience at Parker Hannifin (Macedonia, OH). He specializes in industrial robot cell design, manufacturing automation consulting, computer vision, additive manufacturing, and robot safety (RIA R15.06 / R15.08). He has identified $55M+ in yearly savings across Parker North American plants and provided technical expertise on 800+ robot cell projects.
